title: lagenophora billardierei var. media
intro: Lagenophora billardierei var. media, commonly known as Bush Daisy, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is traditionally used in Australian herbal medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Bush Daisy are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lagenophora billardierei var. media include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
